unharnessed.meaning: Every point survives, commands and links intact: "you shouldn't expect big formatting changes down the track", "If you're feeling confident, use `--fast`."
unharnessed.sense: "fiddly bits", "Have a squiz", "get cracking", "down the track" fit; "no-nonsense" is a little softer than "uncompromising", which is the project's point.
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural Australian English in a README voice: "grab one of the PyInstaller-built standalone executables", "brainpower for the stuff that actually matters".
unharnessed.register: A light level 2 touch: "squiz", "get cracking", "down the track", otherwise plain. No swearing.
unharnessed.tone: Stays a confident, practical README: "Black makes code review quicker by producing the smallest diffs possible."
unharnessed.flow: Reads smoothly: "After a while the formatting stops being something you notice, and you can focus on the content instead."
unharnessed.variety: Varied, though a reader sees "have a look" and "Have a squiz" doing the same job; "fiddly bits", "grab", "get cracking", "down the track".
unharnessed.essence: Unmistakably the Black README, with its "Any colour you like." motto.

dinkum-3.meaning: Every point survives: "Now that we're stable, don't go expecting big formatting changes down the track."; "One more thing:" is colour.
dinkum-3.sense: "the Python code formatter that won't budge" catches "uncompromising"; "Heaps of projects", "the full rundown", "have a squiz" fit.
dinkum-3.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian developer writing: "Want to format Jupyter Notebooks as well?", "just grab one of the PyInstaller-built standalone executables".
dinkum-3.register: Light level 2 touch, a shade chattier than A: "won't budge", "Heaps", "squiz", "don't go expecting". No swearing.
dinkum-3.tone: Keeps the confident, practical README tone: "If you're feeling confident, use `--fast`."
dinkum-3.flow: Reads like it was written that way: "After a while you stop even noticing the formatting, and you can get on with the content instead."
dinkum-3.variety: Varied with nothing leaned on: "won't budge", "fiddly bits", "get cracking", "Heaps", "down the track", "rundown", "squiz".
dinkum-3.essence: Unmistakably the Black README; "won't budge" keeps its uncompromising character.

yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every point survives: "Black checks that the reformatted code still produces a valid AST".
yarn-dinkum.sense: "heaps of projects", "have a squiz", "get cracking" fit; "Now that we've gone stable" strains (projects "become" stable, "gone" suggests a switch), and "no-nonsense" softens "uncompromising".
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural Australian English: "grab one of the PyInstaller-built standalone executables", "down the track".
yarn-dinkum.register: Light level 2 touch: "heaps", "squiz", "get cracking", "down the track". No swearing.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Keeps the practical README tone throughout.
yarn-dinkum.flow: Mostly smooth, but "After a while the formatting stops getting noticed" is a clumsy passive.

yarn-troppo.meaning: The steps survive, but "Sign up for it" implies a subscription, and "Less to wade through, less to argue about." adds a claim the original does not make; "Easy as." is colour.
yarn-troppo.sense: Several terms strain: "won't take no for an answer" means pushy, not uncompromising; "churning out the smallest diffs possible" suggests mass output where the point is minimal change; "Sign up for it" for "By using it".
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Plenty of natural idiom ("banging on at you", "won't play ball", "Feeling game?"), but packed so densely it starts to read as a showcase: "a stack more info", "the nitty-gritty", "Easy as."
yarn-troppo.register: Heavier than a level 2: idioms in almost every sentence ("hand over the reins", "get stuck into", "shake-ups", "Feeling game?") plus added tags. No swearing.
yarn-troppo.tone: Still a README, but the stream of quips ("Easy as.", "Less to wade through, less to argue about.") makes it breezier than the original's crisp confidence.
yarn-troppo.flow: Readable, but the density of idiom piles up: "Sign up for it and you're agreeing to hand over the reins on all the fiddly little bits of hand-formatting."
yarn-troppo.variety: Very varied: "banging on", "get stuck into", "won't play ball", "a stack more", "shake-ups", "nitty-gritty".
yarn-troppo.essence: Recognisably the Black README, but "won't take no for an answer" turns principled rigidity into pushiness.

engine.meaning: The original word for word: "By using it, you agree to cede control over minutiae of hand-formatting."
engine.sense: No Aussie terms to misfire; only the spelling in "Any colour you like." changes.
engine.authenticity: Plain international English with no Australian voice at all: "Further information can be found in our docs".
engine.register: Untranslated apart from "colour"; nowhere near a level 2 light touch.
engine.variety: No slang at all to vary.

summaries.unharnessed: Light, natural and faithful; right on the brief.
summaries.dinkum-3: Natural, faithful and varied; the best of the set.
summaries.yarn-dinkum: Light and faithful, a little less polished than A.
summaries.yarn-troppo: Colourful and varied but over the brief, with several terms in the wrong sense.
summaries.engine: The original with one spelling change; fails the brief.
